_about: Isocrates in English: J. H. Freese, The Orations of Isocrates, vol. 1 (Bohn, 1894), raw IA OCR; Freese's projected second volume was never published.

_excluded.George Norlin and La Rue Van Hook, Loeb: Norlin's vols. 1-2 (1928-29) now held from Perseus, English only: eleven speeches (isocrates-perseus-norlin-*). Van Hook's vol. 3 (1945) is not public domain and is not taken
